body.prose:
Where the reader looks is the URL's to say: the expression the root is offered, said as text, and the component it is looked at with. So a URL is shared, bookmarked or reloaded as it is, and lands where it says, and back and forward are only the address changing; how it is said, and what is kept of it in the field, [the interface](ref:01M6JZY20ZJAAP3CBJ4KRDBXFD) tells. A reader laid over another place, not the root, needs no address.

Whether glass will want anything like pages, with a whole other way of drawing behind a press, is left until there is a site to want it.

*On 2026-11-01 the author found a holon's address in the URL strange, and the root's versions were to be the history; [late on 2026-11-03](ref:01M6HP9PNA0FGNZ6W8DEJ51TX5) he took the URL as the source of truth, as it still has to be real history.*
body.title: The address is where one looks
